title: Dynamic surge slot leasing and provisional invoicing
creator: Aisha Navarro
description: Implement a lease-based surge capacity model for Dedicated customers that offers provisional 'surge slots' to absorb short traffic spikes while producing clear, predictable invoice artifacts. This ticket covers orchestration (slot allocation + decay), admission control heuristics, provisional invoicing records (line-item creation and reconciliation), console visibility, and operator overrides. The goal is to reduce customer-visible throttles during short spikes while avoiding surprise overage charges by creating provisional invoice windows and a reconciliation flow.
acceptance_criteria: API: admin and tenant-facing controls to request and release surge slots (max_surge_slots, requested_duration_sec, priority_tier)
Orchestration: slot leases are allocated from a surge pool and expire automatically; decay and reclaim policies documented and configurable
Billing: provisional invoice line-items created for provisional slots within 1 minute of allocation; final reconciliation occurs within 24 hours with clear delta reporting
Console: per-tenant surge dashboard showing active slots, historical surge events, provisional vs. finalized charges
Reliability: no more than 1% additional latency p50 for requests during surge slot admission; autoscaler compatibility preserved
Operator UX: on-call can force-release slots and trigger immediate reconciliation; action logged in audit trail
progress_updates: 2025-01-21 - Discovery: interviewed two enterprise customers to validate acceptable grace windows and invoice tolerances. Customers prefer a 4-24 hour reconciliation window and a provisional flag on invoices.

2025-01-28 - Spec drafted: Confluence doc created with slot model, admission controls, and reconciliation flows (see links). Decided on lease durations in seconds and a soft-priority queue for fair-share admission.
2025-02-04 - Prototype: implemented surge pool allocator in staging runtime (feature-branch). Basic lease, decay timer, and metrics emitted (surge.slots.allocated, surge.slot_duration_seconds).
2025-02-12 - Early QA: found race where simultaneous lease expiry + autoscaler downscale caused double-reclaim; added conditional reclaim locks and idempotency token to allocator API.

2025-02-20 - Billing integration: provisional line-item schema added to billing service. Drafted reconciliation job to reconcile provisional entries with final capacity consumption. Generated sample invoice artifacts for product and finance review.
2025-02-24 - Design review: Console mockups reviewed with UX; added per-tenant surge timeline and example invoice drilldown. Feedback: show projected cost range before accepting provisional slots.
2025-02-28 - Implementation: operator override API + audit logging merged to staging. Preparing E2E tests and integration test with billing sandbox.
decisions: Lease model vs token-bucket: Chosen lease model because it produces discrete, auditable allocations that map to invoice line-items and are easier for customers to reason about.
Provisional invoice window: Default reconciliation window set to 24 hours with tenant opt-in to shorter (4h) windows. Default balances operational simplicity vs. customer cashflow preferences.
Fairness scoring: Implement soft-priority fair-share admission (tenant_priority * inverse_recent_usage) to avoid starvation by noisy tenants. Hard quotas still honored for reserved capacity.

Billing treatment for reclaimed unused slots: Provisional charge applied at allocation, reconciled down if >50% of slot capacity unused during lease; finance requested conservative refund policy to limit invoice churn.
qa_plan: Integration test against billing sandbox that simulates allocate->use 10%, allocate->use 110% and allocate->not-used scenarios
Chaos test: concurrent allocate/release with autoscaler downscale to validate reclaim idempotency
Load test: synthetic tenant traffic bursts at 2x/5x/10x baseline to verify latency SLOs and admission fairness
Manual sign-off: Product + Finance review of provisional invoice UX and sample reconciled invoices
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): feature flags enabled for internal tenants and 2 pilot customers
Phase 2 (limited GA): open to all Dedicated customers on request; default opt-out for provisional invoices
Phase 3 (GA): enabled in console with opt-in toggles and tenant-level defaults; monitor invoice disputes for first 30 days
next_steps: Finish E2E tests and schedule pilot with two enterprise customers (legal to approve provisional invoice terms)
Implement pre-commit check to show projected provisional cost in console before tenant accepts slot request
Add telemetry to billing dashboard to measure provisional churn rate and reconciliation delta
